_comment: Shared fixture for scripture anchor matching. Python resolves anchors when
TypeScript resolves them again at display time to build the track
(src/lib/scripture/anchor.ts). The two must agree, or a suggestion that
verified on save silently fails to appear on screen.

normalize.name: plain
normalize.input: Bless the Lord O my soul
normalize.expected: bless the lord o my soul

normalize.name: smart apostrophe folds to ascii
normalize.input: And the river won’t take what I have
normalize.expected: and the river won't take what i have

normalize.name: straight apostrophe is unchanged
normalize.input: And the river won't take what I have
normalize.expected: and the river won't take what i have

normalize.name: slash is a line break
normalize.input: I will set my hope / On steady ground
normalize.expected: i will set my hope on steady ground

normalize.name: newline is a line break
normalize.input:
I will set my hope
On steady ground
normalize.expected: i will set my hope on steady ground

slides.lyrics:
Morning light upon the hills
we wake and sing

I will set my hope
On steady ground
And the river won’t take what I have

I will set my hope
On steady ground

resolve.name: line in two places hits both
every_repeat false takes the first only
straight apostrophe matches curly slide text

anchor.lyric: And the river won't take what I have

resolve.name: curly apostrophe matches curly slide text

anchor.lyric: And the river won’t take what I have
I will set my hope / On steady ground

resolve.name: section key narrows nothing when the line is only there
stale section key widens rather than losing the anchor
unmatched line resolves to nothing not slide zero

anchor.lyric: a line from a different song entirely

resolve.name: section wide anchor covers the section
partial line matches the slide containing it
empty lyric with unknown section matches nothing
